item.tib: sa 'dul bar bya ba'i sngags kyi gar 'chams kyi bkod pa klu rgyal gdings kha'i phyag rgya rnam rol yid dbang gter 'dzin
item.coloph: de ltar gar 'cham klu rgyal gdengs pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba 'di dag dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis brtsams nas bde ba'i yan lag tu byas pa blo gsal mchog gyur kun gyi spyad par rigs/ gang de mkhas spyod zhing gi lho shar gnas tshe/ dpa' bo phyag rgya bsgyar ming tshul gnas ltar/ bkod pa'i brjod byang yi ger btab pa la/ mkha' 'gro d+ha ki'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ gaMyung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyan dam par gyur nas dge legs 'phel//
